summary: Strategy Inc filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 7.01/8.01) disclosing weekly at-the-market program activity and bitcoin holdings updates. During August 24-30, 2026, the company sold 4,531,421 Class A common shares for $602.8 million in net proceeds, with no preferred sales. Proceeds funded STRC dividends ($50.7M), bitcoin purchases ($369.7M), STRC repurchases ($151.8M), and cash liquidity ($30.0M). Remaining ATM capacity: $19.09B MSTR, $1.62B STRF, $17.51B STRC, $2.10B STRK, $4.01B STRD. This is ordinary securities issuance and treasury disclosure, not a special situation; watch ongoing dilution and bitcoin accumulation pace.
